about_the_game:
Havenhold is an Action Sandbox MMO set in an ancient Eastern world. 

Wield powerful Primordial Avatars and engage in real-time conflict between rival Mountain Sects. Experience dynamic combat with parry, block, and directional attacks in skill-based duels, large-scale 100 player siege wars, and chaotic open-world skirmishes.

Outside of battle, craft gear, gather resources, and make strategic choices to build your tribe’s power. Construct, conquer, and ascend the sacred peak.

PRIMORDIAL AVATARS

Uncover and wield the powers of ancient primordials, each with their own unique set of abilities. Unlock and level up abilities to customize and evolve your play style. 

FOUND YOUR SECT

Create a sect with like-minded warriors and build your mountain stronghold. Unity is the foundation of everything, and teamwork is the ultimate key to victory.

ALL OUT WAR

Victory in Havenhold isn’t just about skill—it’s about commanding the battlefield. Seasonal warfare erupts between rival factions, where every player’s contribution can shift the tides of conflict. Rally your allies, coordinate large-scale assaults, and siege enemy strongholds in brutal PvP battles. Only through strategy, synergy, and sheer force will your faction rise to claim the peak.

TRADE EVERYTHING

From resources and consumables, to crafted gear and cosmetics, trade with other players and accumulate wealth. The world of Havenhold is built upon a player economy where everything has value. 

THE MOUNTAIN CALLS

Whether you're engaged in small skirmishes or larger PvP battles, the stakes are high, and the competition is fierce. Work with your allies, compete for access to the sacred peak - and claim your place at the end of each season.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD R9 270 (2GB VRA with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super or Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

short_description: Havenhold is an Action Sandbox MMO inspired by the ancient Far East. Train as a warrior monk, wield primordial powers, craft, trade, and expand your influence, then unite the martial world through conquest and glory.
